title: Secure First Habitat
briefing: Anchor the first pressurized shelter in the Shoals. Place a thermal vent frame and secure a pressure suit before the tide shifts.
fieldGuide: First Deep Reach campaign step: establish a breathable, stable foothold near the shoals.

objectives.label: Place a Thermal Vent
objectives.detail: Anchor the habitat around an active vent until a proper settlement hull is available.

objectives.label: Obtain a Pressure Suit
objectives.detail: Find or craft a suit that can survive the first pressure boundary.

rewards.label: Vent Crab Shell
rewards.detail: Tough plating salvaged from local vent crabs.

rewards.label: Sunken Sand
rewards.detail: Compressed seabed sediment for early construction.

completionText: Habitat anchored and pressure protection confirmed. The Shoals are hostile, but survivable.
